## Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd (policy CC-1629): theft from a locked office overnight of a soldering station and an oscilloscope at a rented studio on Pike Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 5,876 dollars.

## Facts

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the loss on 16 April 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a rented studio on Pike Street [notice of loss]. The items are a soldering station and an oscilloscope [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 18 April 2026, reference CR/2026/4221 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The file does not state the calendar date of the theft itself, only that it happened overnight [notice of loss], [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents caused by theft at any other premises while in the insured's custody [policy]. The items were at a studio rented by the insured [notice of loss].

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: the items were in a locked container at the time [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: the police report was made on 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 16 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. The theft cannot have occurred after the notice, so it was reported to the police within seven days of the notice [policy]. The exact date of the theft is not in the file, and it should be confirmed for the record.

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss alleged is theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 5,876 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,829 dollars and 1,047 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the policy extract, so none applies under clause 9.1 [policy].
